Fonts UP-Term installs into FONTS: (only the files not there yet; then
FixFonts lists every size in the .font files).

  TopazPro.font 16   'topaz pro' by spot / Divine Stylers (2022): topaz
                     redrawn for square-pixel screens (TopazPro.diz).
  IBM.font 8, 11     the IBM PC (CP437) font from Fred Fish disk 993
                     (https://aminet.net/package/misc/fish/fish-0993),
                     freely distributable.
  IBM.font 16        the VGA 8x16 CP437 font of Moebius, the ANSI art
                     editor (https://github.com/blocktronics/moebius,
                     Apache License 2.0), converted to an Amiga strike
                     font (IBM.readme).

  JetBrainsMono.font 16   JetBrains Mono Regular 2.304 (OFL 1.1, Omarchy's
                     font) drawn as an Amiga strike font, 7 x 16 cells,
                     Latin-1, by tools/gen_jbmono.py at build time (make
                     jbmono). The Amarchy menu opens it on square pixels
                     (JetBrainsMonoLicence/SOURCE.txt: URL, SHA-256, OFL.txt).
                     Not kept in this drawer.

  JetBrainsMono.ttf       The same JetBrains Mono Regular 2.304 TrueType file,
                     copied unchanged by make dist-base and installed to
                     FONTS:. The Amarchy menu draws it antialiased at 12 px
                     first and falls back to the strike above when it does
                     not open (render/fontpair.c ttf_px).

  SymbolsNerdFontMono.ttf   the icons-only Nerd Font, Nerd Fonts 3.5.1
                     (SymbolsNerdFont/SOURCE.txt: URL, SHA-256; MIT.txt and
                     ICON-SETS.md hold its licences). Fetched by `make`, not
                     kept in this drawer.

UP-Term's terminal draws topaz as TopazPro 16, and IBM 8 as IBM 16, on screens with
square pixels (graphics cards, AGA hires interlaced), and the 8-pixel
fonts on the Amiga's tall PAL / NTSC hires pixels -- unless the profile
says font-aspect = off. (Taken from DCTelnet, feature/ibm16-square-pixels.)
